test_cases.title: Filter by brand A shows only matching products
test_cases.objective: Verify: Filter by brand A shows only matching products.
preconditions: The catalogue is seeded with the synthetic 200-product data set.

steps.action: Open the catalogue page.
steps.expected_result: All 200 seeded products are listed.

steps.action: Select the brand filter value "Brand A".
steps.expected_result: Only the 25 seeded products with brand "Brand A" are listed.

test_cases.title: Clearing the brand A filter restores the full list
test_cases.objective: Verify: Clearing the brand A filter restores the full list.

steps.action: Select "Brand A" and then clear the brand filter.
steps.expected_result: All 200 seeded products are listed again.

test_cases.title: No product of another brand appears under brand A
test_cases.objective: Verify: No product of another brand appears under brand A.

steps.action: Select "Brand A" and scroll through every result page.
steps.expected_result: No listed product has a brand other than "Brand A".
